standard.summary: 自动跳过 OOM (显存不足) 的 batch
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Skips a batch that OOMs (runs out of VRAM) automatically
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 自动跳过 OOM (显存不足) 的 batch，而不是直接崩溃。适合显存紧张的情况

advanced_en.principle: Automatically skips batches that hit OOM (out of memory) instead of crashing outright. Useful when VRAM is tight.
